recognize_zh: 抹片中央有一團緊密黏附的小圓藍細胞，核圓至卵圓、互相擠壓成形（nuclear molding），細胞質稀少且邊界不清，周圍帶淡粉紅纖維狀物質，與散在的造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive cluster of small to medium round blue cells
Round to oval nuclei with fine granular chromatin and nuclear molding
Scant, indistinct cytoplasm forming a syncytial-appearing aggregate
Pale pink fibrillary material at the periphery of the cluster
Background blood-rich smear with scattered normal leukocytes
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a tight cohesive aggregate of small to medium-sized round cells with round to oval nuclei, fine granular chromatin, nuclear molding and scant indistinct cytoplasm, with faint fibrillary pink material at its edges, in a blood-rich background with scattered normal leukocytes. The cohesive growth distinguishes these cells from hematopoietic elements. Findings are suggestive of metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation with biopsy immunohistochemistry and clinical correlation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly without cohesion, molding or fibrillary matrix.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and abundant cytoplasm, and megakaryocytes are large and lobulated.

ddx.dx: Other small round cell tumors (Ewing, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These require immunostains (CD99/NKX2.2, desmin/myogenin) versus PHOX2B/synaptophysin to separate.
